RE: Additions and/or revisions to the agenda for the Board meeting of Tuesday, 
September 1, 2026.
19. REVISE:
Protecting Eaton and Palisades Fire Survivors from Fraud,
Predatory Practices, and Contractor Scams
Revised recommendation as submitted by Supervisors Barger and
Horvath: Instruct the Director of Consumer and Business Affairs
(DCBA), in collaboration with the District Attorney, County Counsel, the
Director of Public Works, other relevant County Departments, and in
consultation with other partners such as the Contractors State License
Board to build upon and strengthen existing County consumer
protection and wildfire recovery efforts, including within 30 days,
convening a Taskforce develop and execute a plan of action to address
and curb contractor fraud and other scams targeting Eaton and 
Palisades Fire survivors.
Direct the Director of DCBA, in coordination with the Office of 
Countywide Communications, within 45 days, to implement an 
expanded consumer awareness campaign to provide centralized, 
accessible information via the Recovery LA Website, …
Once developed, the Directors of DCBA, and Aging and 
Disabilities and the Office of Countywide Communications 
should distribute consumer protection materials through existing 
communication channels, community meetings, recovery 
resource centers, online platforms, and partnerships with 
community-based organizations; and integrate the work of the 
Task Force access to the work being done in Directive 1 and the 
consumer awareness campaign into the Altadena and Calabasas 
One-Stop Permitting Centers.  …  (26-5423)
Motion by Supervisor Barger (Exempt From Cluster)
Revised motion by Supervisors Barger and Horvath
Public Comment/Correspondence
Supplemental Agenda For
September 1, 2026
Page 3
20. REVISE:
Implementing Commercial Tenant Protections to Prevent Small 
Business Displacement and Deliver on Thriving Commercial 
Corridors
Revised recommendation as submitted by Supervisors Mitchell and 
Solis: Direct the Director of Consumer and Business Affairs (DCBA), 
in collaboration with the Treasurer and Tax Collector, Department of 
Economic Opportunity (DEO), …
Unless otherwise ordered by the Board or required by law, waive the 
requirements of Board Policy No. 5.100 and authorize the Directors of 
DCBA and DEO to prepare and execute agreements, and any 
amendments to existing agreements, approved as to form by County 
Counsel, with attorneys, consultants, non-profit organizations, or 
community-based organizations, to support the directives of this 
motion.  (26-5180)
Motion by Supervisor Mitchell
Motion by Supervisors Mitchell and Solis (Updates Following Cluster)
Revised motion by Supervisors Mitchell and Solis

90-E. Governance Reform Task Force Labor Representation
Recommendation as submitted by Supervisor Horvath: Find and 
determine that an emergency exists within the meaning of Government 
Code Section 54974, to fill the unscheduled vacancy immediately; and 
accept SEIU Local 721’s nomination of Raymond Meza to the 
Governance Reform Task Force and appoint him to serve as the Labor 
Appointment representing SEIU Local 721 until a permanent 
appointment is made.  (26-5521)
Motion by Supervisor Horvath (Exempt From Cluster)
Public Comment/Correspondence
90-F. Measure ER Allocation: Disbursing Funds Based on Population 
Versus Core Public Health Services
Recommendation as submitted by Supervisors Hahn and Barger: 
Suspend Section 22.1 of the Rules of the Board for the limited purpose 
of considering this motion. Direct the Chief Executive Officer and the 
Director of Public Health to revise the Measure ER spending plan 
language, adopted by the Board on February 10, 2026, for Item 4j, the 
1% allocation to the City of Pasadena Public Health Department and 
the City of Long Beach Department of Health and Human Services by 
changing the basis from “proportionately based on what each city 
spent on core public health services over the past five fiscal years” to 
per capita basis, reviewed and updated annually.
Authorize the Director of Public Health to enter into and/or amend 
agreements with the City of Pasadena Public Health Department and 
the City of Long Beach Department of Health and Human Services to 
add Measure ER funds and to make subsequent Measure ER related 
amendments, without adhering to the requirements of the County’s Sole 
Source Policy or any other competitive procurement requirements and 
terminate said agreements as necessary.  (26-5508)
Motion by Supervisors Hahn and Barger
Public Comment/Correspondence
Supplemental Agenda For
September 1, 2026

1-P. Whittier Narrows Recreation Area Regional Splash Pad
Recommendation as submitted by Supervisor Solis: Allocate 
$549,532.83 in Prop A Excess Funds, available to the First 
Supervisorial District pursuant to the Los Angeles County Safe 
Neighborhood Parks Proposition of 1996, to the Department of Parks 
and Recreation for the Whittier Narrows Recreation Area Regional 
Splash Pad Project. Find that the proposed actions are not subject to 
the California Environmental Quality Act.  (26-5519)
Motion by Supervisor Solis (Exempt From Cluster)
Public Comment/Correspondence
